candidates.comment: In this video, YouTuber “Part Time Pilot” discusses the concept of how a drone stalls in airspace. This is caused by a linear relationship between the lift and angle of attack. As the lift increases and the angle of attack increases, the drone gets closer and closer to what is called a “critical angle”. Beyond this critical angle, the drone stalls due to the lift of the drone dropping to zero. How to recover a stalled air drone is simple. You decrease the drone’s angle of attack using the controller and attempt to lift the drone as it comes down, this will supply airflow over the wing again and allow the drone to stabilize itself.
